demo-youth-voices-in-eu-decisions.txt: Demo Youth Network argues that young people are still consulted too late and too rarely on EU policy. It proposes a standing youth panel, plain-language consultations and feedback on how input was used.
demo-fair-green-transition-young-workers: Demo Climate Coalition calls for a green transition that does not leave young workers behind. It asks for funded retraining, protection from precarious green jobs and a voice for young people in climate planning.
demo-making-exchange-reachable.txt: Demo Mobility Alliance finds that Erasmus-style exchanges still favour students from wealthier families. It proposes higher grants, upfront payment, housing support and mobility for vocational learners.
demo-equal-treatment-in-education.txt: Demo Rights Forum documents discrimination in education based on gender identity, ethnicity, disability and migration background. It asks for binding equality rules, training for staff and safe reporting channels.
demo-simpler-funding-small-organisations: Demo Youth Network shows that complex EU funding rules keep small organisations out of grants. It proposes simpler applications, lump sums, faster payment and a single contact point at the institutions.
demo-civic-education-across-universities: Demo Campus Network reviews how universities teach citizenship and democratic skills. It recommends credit-bearing civic modules, community service learning and student representation in governance.
demo-student-mental-health-support.txt: Demo Student Wellbeing Group reports long waits for counselling and asks for free, quick mental health support in universities and youth services. It also proposes staff training and less exam pressure.
demo-salute-mentale-universita.txt: Rete Demo Studenti segnala tempi di attesa lunghi per il supporto psicologico universitario. Propone sportelli gratuiti, più psicologi, formazione del personale e attenzione allo stress da esami.
demo-mobilita-studentesca-alloggi.txt: Rete Demo Studenti analizza gli ostacoli economici alla mobilità Erasmus in Italia. Chiede borse più alte, anticipo del pagamento, alloggi garantiti e un'informazione più chiara.
La Coalizione Demo Terzo Settore spiega perché le piccole associazioni italiane faticano ad accedere ai fondi europei. Propone procedure semplificate, importi forfettari e assistenza locale.
demo-bien-etre-soutien-psychologique-jeu: Le Réseau Démo Santé Mentale alerte sur le manque de soutien psychologique pour les jeunes. Il demande des consultations gratuites, des professionnels dans les établissements et la lutte contre la stigmatisation.
demo-droits-des-jeunes-participation-cit: Le Forum Démo des Droits examine les droits civiques des jeunes et leur participation. Il propose le vote à seize ans, des conseils de jeunes décisionnaires et un accès simple à l'information.
L'Alliance Démo pour la Paix défend l'éducation à la paix comme outil de prévention des conflits. Elle propose des programmes scolaires, la formation à la médiation et des échanges entre jeunes de régions en tension.
